confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Fiji's tourism pricing, not from inspected booking pages or current listings. Restaurant and bar anchors are moderately certain. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer estimate because direct knowledge is weaker. Accommodation anchors are less certain because Nadi spans budget guesthouses to resort-area hotels, and July is a high season, so rates may run above typical shoulder-season levels.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Pacific island tourism hubs with a mix of backpacker lodging, small guesthouses and resort-area hotels, priced with Fiji's local currency and tourism cost structure in mind. No single named comparable city was used.
